_what: The deferred reads shared by the signed-in workspace and its AI-app view (screen-catalog.mjs). Existing first-answers paths still name the viewer, tool screens and pursuits. Conversations stay deferred, outside firstAnswers.paths, so the Worker never adds their read to the first response; their `path` is null while the engine has no owner for it (macos/release.json route_owner_gate.retired), and the catalog then settles them empty without asking. Their changed-store refresh keeps the existing one-minute limit; the catalog itself never polls. Failure words are shared by hosts that show an incomplete catalog and offer a retry.
